def solve(case):
    payload = case["payload"]
    word_token_indices = payload["word_token_indices"]
    word_labels = payload["word_labels"]
    token_count = payload["token_count"]
    # Validate: same length
    if len(word_token_indices) != len(word_labels):
        raise ValueError("Mismatch between word groups and labels")
    # Initialize token_label array with None
    token_label = [None] * token_count
    # Track coverage
    covered = [False] * token_count
    for idx_list, label in zip(word_token_indices, word_labels):
        for idx in idx_list:
            if not (0 <= idx < token_count):
                raise ValueError(f"Token index {idx} out of range")
            if covered[idx]:
                raise ValueError(f"Overlap at token index {idx}")
            covered[idx] = True
            token_label[idx] = label
    # Check all tokens covered
    for i, c in enumerate(covered):
        if not c:
            raise ValueError(f"Uncovered token index {i}")
    # Now token_label list is filled
    token_labels = token_label  # list of ints 0/1
    retained_indices = [i for i, lbl in enumerate(token_labels) if lbl == 1]
    return {"token_labels": token_labels, "retained_indices": retained_indices}
